NOW WE'RE ON TO THE FIRST ORDER OF BUSINESS WHICH IS TO APPROVE THE MINUTES FROM THE MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 16TH, 2026.
THE MINUTES OF THE SEPTEMBER 16TH MEETING ARE APPROVED.

SO THIS MAKING SURE THAT ALL MY COLLEAGUES KNOW THAT THIS IS NOT THE LAST VOTE THIS IS JUST ANOTHER VOTE TO MAKE SURE THAT WE CAN USE THESE FUNDS.
